sources.title: Visa requirements overview — Islamic Federal Republic of the Comoros
sources.publisher: Ministry of Foreign and European Affairs of the Republic of Croatia
sources.officialityEvidence: The live Croatian Foreign Ministry page separately selects Croatian citizens and ordinary passports, then directly states that Croatian nationals can obtain a visa on arrival for a maximum 45-day stay.
sources.supportingExcerpt: Nationals of Croatia can obtain a visa on arrival for a maximum stay of 45 days.

sources.title: Union of the Comoros — visa regime for citizens of Montenegro
sources.officialityEvidence: The live Government of Montenegro country page directly states the Comoros entry route for Montenegrin citizens and identifies issuance at an airport or border crossing for 45 days.
sources.supportingExcerpt: issued upon arrival at the airport / border crossing, and valid for 45 days

policies.title: Croatian ordinary passports: Comoros visa on arrival
policies.summary: Croatia's current Foreign Ministry visa table selects the ordinary passport and states that Croatian nationals can obtain a Comoros visa on arrival for up to 45 days.
conditions: Applies to a Croatian citizen using an ordinary passport for a short visit of up to 45 days.
The official page establishes arrival issuance but does not publish the fee or supporting-document requirements; confirm these before travel.
Passport validity, purpose restrictions, carrier requirements and final border admission remain separate.

policies.title: Montenegrin ordinary passports: Comoros visa on arrival
policies.summary: Montenegro's current government country page states that its citizens receive the required Comoros visa at an airport or border crossing for a 45-day stay.
conditions: Applies to a Montenegrin citizen using an ordinary passport for a short visit of up to 45 days; special-document routes are outside this policy.
The required visa is issued upon arrival at an airport or border crossing.
Fees, passport validity, supporting documents, carrier requirements and final border admission must be confirmed before travel.
